hints.environment: Sandbox takes test payments, Production takes real ones.
hints.apiLoginId: From Account → Settings → API Credentials & Keys in the Merchant Interface.
hints.transactionKey: Created on the same page as the API Login ID.
hints.publicClientKey: From Account → Settings → Security Settings → General Security Settings → Manage Public Client Key.
hints.signatureKey: Verifies Authorize.net webhooks. Created on the same page as the API Login ID.
hints.capture: With Capture right away, the payment is one-stage and the money is debited right away. With Authorize only, it is two-stage and the amount is held until you capture it.
hints.googlePay: Shows the Google Pay button in the storefront's express checkout row.
hints.googleMerchantId: From the Google Pay & Wallet Console. Needed in production only.
